items.text: A sampled prediction can be traced to compatible model, feature, policy, and serving versions.
Event loss, schema rejection, freshness, and outcome-join coverage have their own monitors.
Service, data, model, and product signals can be compared by release and approved cohort.
Quality jobs exclude immature cohorts and report label coverage beside every labeled metric.
Telemetry is minimized, access-controlled, retained deliberately, and safe for investigation.
Each alert names severity, impact, owner, runbook, and a tested mitigation.
Rollback, fallback, threshold, and review paths are load-tested before an incident.
Exposure, selection, abstention, and review coverage reveal feedback-loop bias.
Automated retraining cannot promote an artifact without independent quality and safety gates.
A resolved incident adds a regression test, monitor, or runbook change tied to its failure mode.
